blind.description: A low, stylized cast-iron brazier or fire pit standing on splayed iron legs, filled with a bed of dark faceted charcoal. Four iron tools or branding irons with warm brown cylindrical handles protrude diagonally out of the coals over the rim, each with different metal toolheads resting in the coals (a ring head, fork prongs, and flat brands). A small curved iron hook or handle segment hangs from the reinforced rim band.
blind.from_above: A circular dark metal basin packed with coarse charcoal chunks, with four branding-iron handles extending parallel out to the right side and cast shadows extending to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 feet tall (reaching around knee height of the 5 ft 9 in figure to the tool handles) and about 2 feet wide across the rim and legs.

notes: Height proportion somewhat squatter than catalog ratio due to splayed tools widening footprint
